name: Assault Formation
oracle_text:

{G}: Target creature with defender can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
{2}{G}: Creatures you control get +0/+1 until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Each creature you control assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
{G}: Target creature with defender can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.

needs.what: a static (Doran/Assault Formation) with an `affects` filter under which each matching creature assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power (rule 510.1a substitution), read by the combat-damage step and by trample/lethal-assignment math
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has buff, set_pt and replace_damage, but set_pt/buff change the creature's real power (wrong for every other power read), and replace_damage only multiplies or adds to damage already computed from power; nothing substitutes toughness for power at assignment

needs.what: a one-shot op with a duration (this_turn) letting the targeted creature attack as though it didn't have defender, while it keeps the defender keyword for everything else
needs.why_existing_wont_do: lose_keyword removes defender outright (it would then stop counting as a defender for filters and other effects), and grant_keyword/must_attack do not lift the attack restriction; no op or static permits attacking despite defender
